drug_name: Adrenalinum / Avena Sativa / Bryonia Alba / Glycine Max (Soy) / Histaminum Hydrochloricum / Barley / Lycopodium Clavatum / Natrum Muriaticum / Pulsatilla Pratensis / Rye / Wheat / Corn (Homeopathic Combination)
what_its_for: This homeopathic combination product is used to temporarily relieve common allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, watery or itchy eyes, nasal congestion, and mild skin irritation. It may also help with hay fever-like symptoms triggered by grains, grasses, and environmental allergens like pollen. It is NOT a prescription medicine and is not proven to treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Always talk to your doctor if your symptoms are severe or do not improve.
how_to_take: Take this medicine exactly as directed on the product label or as recommended by your healthcare provider. Most forms come as oral drops, sublingual (under-the-tongue) tablets, or dissolvable pellets. For drops: place the recommended number of drops under your tongue or in a small amount of water and swallow. For tablets or pellets: place them under your tongue and let them dissolve completely — do not chew or swallow them whole. Try to take this medicine at least 15 to 30 minutes before or after eating, drinking, or brushing your teeth for best results. Wash your hands before handling pellets or tablets.
dosing: Dosing varies by product and age. A typical adult dose is 3 to 5 pellets or 10 to 15 drops taken 3 times per day. For children, always follow the child-specific dosing on the label or ask your pharmacist. Do not exceed the recommended dose listed on your specific product. If you are unsure of the correct dose, ask your pharmacist or healthcare provider before use.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double up or take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store at room temperature, between 59°F and 77°F (15°C to 25°C). Keep away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture. Do not store in the bathroom or near the kitchen sink. Keep the container tightly closed when not in use. Keep this product out of reach of children and pets. Do not use after the expiration date printed on the package.
what_to_avoid: Avoid strong-smelling substances such as camphor, menthol, eucalyptus, coffee, and mint products (including mint-flavored toothpaste) close to the time you take this medicine, as these may reduce its effectiveness. Avoid eating or drinking for at least 15 minutes before and after taking your dose. Do not handle pellets with bare hands more than necessary — use the cap or a clean spoon to dispense them. Avoid exposing the product to strong light, electromagnetic fields (such as X-ray machines), or extreme temperatures.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or seek immediate medical attention if you experience: a severe allergic reaction (difficulty breathing, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, hives, or rapid heartbeat); symptoms that worsen significantly or do not improve within 7 days of use; fever, chest pain, or shortness of breath; signs of a serious infection; or any new or unexpected symptoms. Also contact your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, have a serious medical condition, or are taking other medications.
when_it_works: Some people may notice a mild improvement in allergy symptoms within a few days of starting treatment. Full benefit may take 2 to 4 weeks of consistent use for some individuals. Results can vary from person to person. If you do not notice any improvement after 4 weeks of use, speak with your doctor or pharmacist to discuss other treatment options.
special_populations: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: Safety has not been fully established. Talk to your doctor before using this product if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Children: Some formulations are safe for children 2 years and older, but always check the product label for age-specific guidance and consult a pediatrician before giving to young children. Elderly: No special dose adjustments are generally required, but elderly patients with multiple health conditions or on multiple medications should consult a healthcare provider before use. Soy/Grain Allergies: This product contains soy (Glycine max), wheat, barley, rye, and corn ingredients. If you have a known allergy or intolerance to any of these substances, do not use this product without first speaking to your doctor.
